newsitem.title: USA: Dairy Queen taps Grey Advertising in US.
newsitem.headline: Dairy Queen taps Grey Advertising in US.

text.p: International Dairy Queen Inc said Tuesday it has selected Grey Advertising Inc as its new agency of record for the U.S. portion of its "Dairy Queen" account.
Full details of the agreement have not been disclosed, but the frozen dairy and other food restaurant chain's estimated media billing for 1998 will be $25 million, Dairy Queen said.
Grey will succeed Minneapolis-based Campbell Mithun Esty -- the agency of record since 1962 and a unit of Cordiant Plc, Dairy Queen said.
Grey shares were down eight at 322 Tuesday, while Dairy Queen shares were unchanged at 24.
